observation.command: kill 1554 1555 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; ps -p 1554 -p 1555 2>/dev/null; echo "---remaining node procs---"; ps aux | grep -E 'webpack|http.server' | grep -v grep; echo "---listening ports---"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f "$f" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); printf "%d\n", ("0x" a[2])+0}' "$f"; done | sort -un; echo "cleanup done"
